vitriol furget me not black crop zip jac.name: Vitriol Furget Me Not Black Crop Zip Jacket
vitriol furget me not black crop zip jac.description: Made with a black faux-fur construction by Vitriol, the Furget Me Not crop zip jacket combines a disturbed gothic style with a lavish streetwear silhouette. Offering a full zip closure with a 3D-molded metallic pull tab, the front and sleeves are decorated with contrasting red cybersigilism embroidery while a brand logo graces the left hand pocket for a designer vibe. Complete with an adjustable drawstring in the hood and a hidden internal stash pocket with zip closure, this warm layer provides toasty comfort without sacrificing your edgy look.
